# Crown Asia Projects — Belterre, Chateau Nissa & Granvida

> Three Crown Asia communities in Bulacan, Philippines. Verified house models, sample computations from the official project files, and a consultant who answers only from those files.

## Projects

- Belterre by Crown Asia — KM 37, Pulong Buhangin, Sta. Maria, Bulacan. 2.13 hectares, 65 lots.
- Chateau Nissa by Crown Asia — Plaridel, Bulacan. French Mediterranean-inspired enclave, 7.9 hectares, 226 lots, lot range 140–306 sqm.
- Granvida by Crown Asia — Tangos, Baliwag, Bulacan. 4.4 hectares, 137 lots.

## House models (same across all three projects, all two-storey)

- Grand Lladro — 219 sqm floor area, minimum lot 192 sqm, 3 bedrooms.
- Lladro — 211 sqm floor area, minimum lot 192 sqm, 3 bedrooms.
- Topaz — 171 sqm floor area, minimum lot 149 sqm, 4 bedrooms.
- Garnet — 162 sqm floor area, minimum lot 141 sqm, 4 bedrooms.

## Sample computations

Sample computations on the page are quoted from the official project files for one lot per model per project, including total contract price, outright discount, reservation fee, downpayment terms, bank financing, and spot-cash terms. Prices are snapshots from those files and are subject to change; confirm current figures with the consultant.
